skills.name: Unlike Denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator to subtract fractions that have different denominators.

skills.name: Like-Denominator Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions directly when they already share the same denominator (no whole number parts involved).

skills.name: Mixed Number Subtraction (No Regrouping)
skills.definition: Subtract the whole number parts and fractional parts of mixed numbers separately when the minuend's fraction is greater than or equal to the subtrahend's fraction.

skills.name: Regrouping/Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrow one whole unit (converting it into an equivalent fraction) when the subtrahend's fraction exceeds the minuend's fraction or when subtracting from/into a whole number.

skills.name: Simplify Fraction
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to its lowest terms.

skills.name: Improper Fractional Part Conversion
skills.definition: Recognize and convert a mixed number whose fractional part is equal to or greater than one into standard mixed-number form.
